Colleague.title: Colleague
Colleague.description: DHL Colleague and user account profile for authentication, OTP verification, and role-based access control.

id.description: Unique identifier for the colleague profile.

role.description: Access role (Facility Agent, HoD, or superadmin).

facility.description: Assigned DHL facility (PNHGTW, PNHASC, PNHSVC, All).

phoneNumbers.description: List of associated phone numbers for login.

SystemSetting.title: SystemSetting
SystemSetting.description: Global system and authentication configuration settings.

lastUpdatedBy.description: Name or username of user who last modified settings.

/colleagues/{colleagueId}.description: Collection storing registered DHL colleague profiles, roles, and phone numbers for OTP login.
